messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · ID 2087 · SEV: P1? · Resource: eu-west-1 write path
incident-bot: Alerts: write-error-rate > 5% for hosted-api-prod-eu since 2026-03-15T12:03Z. War room: https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/2087 PagerDuty: PD-12345 · escalation level 2
alex: I'm on-call and I see the PD page. paging now to oncall DB and SRE. joining war room in 1min :phone:
maria: joining war room. can someone pick an incident owner?
jonathan: I'll take owner. heading into war room. quick summary: elevated 500s on write endpoints for eu customers. suspected backend DB write latency + timeouts.
alex: PD escalation complete. notes: error spikes coincide with a new rollout (2026-03-15-1520) that touched write gateway.
deploy-bot: candidate rollback available: rollout/2026-03-15-1520
deploy-bot: possible rollback command:
```
./scripts/rollback.sh rollout/2026-03-15-1520
```
sre-lead: small morning checklist: 1) Attach owner (jonathan) 2) Attempt fast rollback if safe 3) Prepare DB failover if rollback no-go 4) Status page draft 5) Keep cadence 15m
maria: initial impact assessment: partial write failures for ~10% of requests in eu-west-1, read paths unaffected, no confirmed data loss yet. customer visible: some hosted-api customers report 500 errors when saving models. severity: customer-visible degradation, recommend P1 until mitigated.
jonathan: status page draft (use this and copy to status.redwood.ai):
"Investigating: We are aware of elevated 500 responses for write operations in the EU region. Our SRE and engineering teams are actively investigating. No confirmed data loss at this time. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."
alex: logs show repeated `timeout waiting for ack` from write-gateway pods. sample command: 
```
kubectl -n prod logs deployment/write-gateway -c gateway --since=10m | grep timeout
```
sre-lead: quick mitigation plan: 
- Attempt rollback of rollout/2026-03-15-1520 (alex)
- If rollback fails or doesn't reduce errors, initiate DB replica failover to replica-2 (alice)
- Notify CS to post initial status and customer guidance (cs-lead)
- Keep war room open and update cadence
cs-lead: I'll draft customer-facing message. Proposed customer wording:
"We are investigating intermittent write failures affecting EU-hosted customers. We are actively working on a mitigation and will provide updates every 15 minutes. No action required from customers at this time; reach out to support if you see ongoing errors." :email:
alex: I'm starting rollback now: `./scripts/rollback.sh rollout/2026-03-15-1520` — posting progress in war room.
maria: ACK. If rollback fails, proceed to DB failover runbook (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/db-failover). Also keep metrics pinned: error-rate, p50/p95 latency, write success count.
jonathan: action items and owners (to track in ticket):
- rollback attempt: alex (in progress)
- DB replica failover plan: alice (standby)
- status page updates + customer comms: cs-lead (immediate)
- logs & root cause triage: maria + sre-lead
- add chronology & timeline to incident ticket: jonathan
alex: rollback started -> step 1/3 applied to gateway. will watch - if >1% improvement in 3m we continue, otherwise revert and escalate to failover.
cs-lead: customer comms posted draft to status page staging. posting now to `status.redwood.ai/incidents/2087` and on Slack CS channel.
maria: planning handoff: current oncall (alex) will try mitigation; if unresolved by 20:00 UTC handoff to night oncall (emma). please add handoff note to ticket with time and outstanding items.
incident-bot: REMINDER: please update incident ticket https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-2087 with owner, impact, and chronology. Next automated check-in at 15 minutes.
jonathan: thanks team. keep updates concise here. if you post logs include redacted PII.
alex: rolling back complete — gateway rollout reverted, error rate dropped to ~0.8% within 4m. monitoring for 15m.
maria: monitoring shows error rate falling. keeping P1 until stable for 30m. preparing RCA skeleton in the ticket.
cs-lead: customers updated. will send high-touch notes to top 10 affected customers.
jonathan: leaving the war room in 30m if stable; will handoff to maria for watch and documentation.
